Which statement explains why isotopes of the same element have the same chemical properties?
A
They have the same number of outer shell electrons.
B
They have the same number of neutrons.
C
They have different numbers of protons.
D
They have different mass numbers.

options.label: A
options.text: They have the same number of outer shell electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: They have the same number of neutrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have different numbers of protons.
